verdict.rationale: Omnara's pricing page states it is 'Open source under Apache 2.0' and free to self-host, and its homepage brands it as an open-source alternative. A public GitHub repository (omnara-ai/omnara) with readable project content backs this up. A community remark hints Omnara may not always have been open source, but that is skepticism, not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: the license file is not quoted directly from the repository, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation that the full source is published under that license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0.
Omnara — The open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents
Self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres for analytics, evals, prompt analysis, and training datasets.
